name: Rubber Segment
description: Segmented radio control with a draggable thumb that stretches like rubber between options, squashes on landing, resists at the edges and flicks with momentum. Keyboard accessible.
contents: Track with one button per item (optional icon plus label)
Thumb layer clipped to the active segment that shows the inverted text color
behavior: Clicking a segment stretches the thumb across both slots then settles into the target with a small squash
Thumb can be dragged, with rubber-band resistance past the ends and velocity-based flick to the next segment
Arrow keys, Home and End change the selection and move focus
Works controlled (value) or uncontrolled (defaultValue) and calls onChange with value and index
Respects reduced motion by jumping without animation
Re-measures on resize and when fonts finish loading
editableByProps: Options, labels and icons, selected value
Track, thumb, text and active text colors
Size preset, corner radius, inner padding
Stretch, squash, speed and glide feel
Dragging and disabled state, extra classes, aria label

needsCodeEdit.change: Tune edge resistance, flick threshold and drag deadzone

needsCodeEdit.where: grid-flow-col classes on the track and thumb div, and the clipPath inset in useTransform

fixed: Requires the motion package and Tailwind CSS with arbitrary value support
Horizontal layout only, vertical arrow keys also move selection
Each item value must be unique, it is used as the React key
Not a form field, no hidden input
Inline-grid sized by content, fixed heights from the size preset
Disabled state is set to 50% opacity
Works on small screens with touch drag, vertical page panning stays enabled
